home.whychoose.title: Why Choose Us?
home.whychoose.description: We are the oldest diving center in the area, with over 40 years of experience in Puerto Madryn, the national capital of diving. We combine the expertise of two generations, father and son, to offer exceptional diving and snorkeling experiences.
home.whychoose.feature1.title: Experience and Expertise
home.whychoose.feature1.description: With more than four decades dedicated to diving in the region, we are leaders in the field and know the secrets of the Golfo Nuevo like no one else.
home.whychoose.feature2.title: Personalized Attention
home.whychoose.feature2.description: Our dedicated team ensures that every customer receives personalized attention, tailored to their needs and abilities.
home.whychoose.feature3.title: Guaranteed Security
home.whychoose.feature3.description: Our safety protocols, experience and planning are key to ensuring that each dive is a safe and enjoyable experience.
home.whychoose.feature4.title: Reviews That Speak for Themselves
home.whychoose.feature4.description: Discover why our clients choose us time and time again. Read the reviews and testimonials that reflect the quality and excellence of our underwater experiences.
home.whychoose.feature5.title: Warm and Family Atmosphere
home.whychoose.feature5.description: At our center, you'll feel at home from the moment you arrive. Our welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere is part of what makes us special.
home.whychoose.feature6.title: We explore the New Gulf
home.whychoose.feature6.description: We explore natural parks, shipwrecks, and the sea lion reserve, offering unique experiences for all levels, from beginners to Dive Masters.
home.whychoose.visualCaption: We know this sea because we grew up in it.
home.padi.title: PADI Courses
home.padi.description: Get certified with us and discover a world of underwater possibilities.
home.padi.subTitle: Get certified with us
home.padi.paragraph.1: As an authorized PADI center, we offer a wide range of diving courses for all levels, from beginners to advanced, and provide specialized support to diving schools.
home.padi.paragraph.2: Our team of certified instructors will guide you step by step through your training, ensuring a safe, professional, and exciting experience in every dive.
home.reseñas.title: What Our Clients Say
home.reseñas.description: Discover why we are the top-rated diving center in Puerto Madryn
home.reseña.1.name: Andrés Thomas Guldman
home.reseña.1.text: Unforgettable experience. Best value for money. The team was super friendly and very kind. Extremely patient when teaching, and they paid attention to every single detail to make everything spectacular. I highly recommend snorkeling with sea lions.
home.reseña.2.name: Veronica Giorlando
home.reseña.2.text: Incredible sea lion snorkeling experience. Everyone was very professional, explaining everything thoroughly for an excellent excursion. They provide everything you need to enjoy it: wetsuits, ponchos, lockers.
home.reseña.3.name: Laura Martínez
home.reseña.3.text: Amazing service and customer care. A young, energetic team with deep diving knowledge. They made the PADI certification process truly enjoyable. 100% recommended. Special thanks to Lucio (instructor), Julián (boat captain), Kamila, and Mauro.

courses.padi.title: PADI Courses
courses.padi.description: Get certified with us and discover a world of possibilities beneath the surface.
courses.padi.description.1: Discover the fascinating underwater world in the stunning Patagonia with our diving courses, designed for all levels. As a PADI dive center, we guarantee the highest quality instruction and safety.
courses.padi.description.2: Find out why Puerto Madryn is recognized as the national capital of diving, offering you a unique experience in the waters of the Golfo Nuevo.
courses.padi.description.3: From getting started in diving to becoming an expert, our certified instructors will guide you every step of the way.
courses.padi.description.4: As an official PADI (Professional Association of Diving Instructors) dive center, we offer internationally recognized certifications.
courses.padi.description.5: PADI is the world's largest and most respected dive training organization, with rigorous standards and proven methodologies that ensure high-quality and safe training.

cursos.discover.title: Discover Scuba Diving
cursos.discover.shortDescription: A beginner diving experience where you'll learn the basics and enjoy your first open-water dive.
cursos.discover.description: If you're interested in diving but unsure about enrolling in a full certification course, Discover Scuba Diving is the perfect way to test the waters. In a short time, you'll learn basic diving skills and breathe underwater for the first time. A highly trained PADI professional will provide the diving equipment, explain basic diving techniques, and answer any questions you may have.
cursos.discover.includes.1: Introduction to diving guided by your instructor
cursos.scuba.title: Scuba Diver
cursos.scuba.shortDescription: Earn your basic diving certification, allowing you to dive under the supervision of a professional up to 12 meters deep.
cursos.scuba.description: Want to start diving but not ready to commit to a full course? We offer a great alternative to ease you into this world: you can complete the first three modules of the Open Water Diver course and earn the Scuba Diver certification. This option is ideal for those who want to explore diving gradually, with shorter sessions and constant guidance. With this certification, you can dive up to 12 meters deep, always accompanied by a professional, and it allows you to progress to the Open Water Diver certification if you choose to continue your training.
cursos.scuba.duration: Online theory 3-7 hours, full course 2-3 days.
cursos.scuba.includes.0: Complete equipment for all your dives
cursos.scuba.includes.2: In-person theoretical and practical classes with your instructor
cursos.scuba.qualifications.0: Dive under the direct supervision of a PADI professional up to a maximum depth of 12 meters anywhere in the world.
cursos.scuba.qualifications.1: Obtain air fills, rent or purchase diving equipment, and participate in diving activities as long as properly supervised.
cursos.scuba.qualifications.2: Continue your diving training by completing the PADI Open Water Diver certification and taking certain specialty courses.
cursos.owd.title: Open Water Diver
cursos.owd.shortDescription: Get certified as an open water diver and access exclusive dive sites up to 18 meters deep anywhere in the world.
cursos.owd.description: The PADI Open Water Diver course is designed to make you a confident and skilled diver. Through theoretical and practical training, you'll learn to assemble and use scuba gear, control your buoyancy, approach marine life respectfully, and manage common issues. The course includes pool sessions, open-water dives, and online theory to prepare you for diving adventures worldwide. With this certification, you can dive up to 18 meters and explore a wide range of dive sites independently or with a buddy.
cursos.owd.duration: Online theory 5-10 hours, full course 4-5 days.
cursos.owd.includes.0: Complete equipment for all your dives
cursos.owd.includes.2: In-person theoretical and practical classes with your instructor
cursos.owd.learningOutcomes.0: Be a safe and skilled diver.
cursos.owd.learningOutcomes.1: Assemble and use scuba diving equipment.
cursos.AOW.title: Advanced Open Water
cursos.AOW.shortDescription: Expand your diving skills and experience by exploring new areas of interest under the supervision of an instructor.
cursos.AOW.description: The PADI Advanced Open Water International course focuses on enhancing your diving skills, building confidence, and developing your abilities through specialty dives. This course includes 5 specialized dives. Of the 5 specialty modules, two are mandatory: Deep Diving and Underwater Navigation. The other three modules are elective, chosen from the PADI manual, allowing you to customize your learning experience. You have up to one year to complete the course. One of the optional specialties you can choose is diving with sea lions in a protected natural area, within the Naturalist module.
cursos.AOW.duration: Online theory 6-8 hours, full course 2-3 days.
cursos.AOW.includes.0: Complete equipment for all your dives
cursos.AOW.includes.2: In-person theoretical and practical classes with your instructor
cursos.AOW.requirements.1: Open Water Diver/Junior Open Water Diver (or equivalent certification)
cursos.AOW.learningOutcomes.2: Use a compass and learn about underwater navigation.
cursos.efr.title: Emergency First Response (EFR)
cursos.efr.shortDescription: Learn first aid and CPR techniques to be prepared for emergencies both on land and underwater.
cursos.efr.description: The Emergency First Response (EFR) course equips you with the knowledge and skills needed to handle emergencies both on land and related to diving. You'll learn to perform CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation), use an AED (Automated External Defibrillator), control bleeding, manage injuries and illnesses, and respond to emergencies. This course is a prerequisite for the Rescue Diver course and is internationally recognized as a high-quality first aid training program.
cursos.efr.duration: Online theory 2-4 hours, full course 6-8 hours
cursos.efr.learningOutcomes.1: Assist someone who is not breathing normally.
cursos.efr.learningOutcomes.2: Increase the patient’s chances of survival.
cursos.rescue.title: Rescue Diver
cursos.rescue.shortDescription: Learn to prevent and manage problems in the water and become a safer, more aware diver.
cursos.rescue.description: The Rescue Diver course primarily focuses on rescue exercises both in and out of the water, with a lesser emphasis on recreational diving. Participants will complete 5 modules that include rescue practices and theory, following the PADI manual. This course is designed to prepare you with rescue skills for various situations and to monitor the well-being of your dive buddies. The PADI Rescue Diver course will transform the way you dive in the best way possible. Learn to identify and fix minor problems before they become major issues, gain significant confidence, and have serious fun along the way. Discover why countless divers say Rescue Diver is their favorite diving course.
cursos.rescue.duration: Online theory 8-12 hours, full course 4-7 days.
cursos.rescue.includes.0: Complete equipment for all your dives
cursos.rescue.includes.2: In-person theoretical and practical classes with your instructor
cursos.rescue.requirements.0: Adventure Diver/Junior Adventure Diver (or equivalent certification) with completed underwater navigation dive
cursos.rescue.requirements.1: EFR Primary and Secondary Care training (or equivalent) within the last 24 months
cursos.divemaster.title: Divemaster
cursos.divemaster.shortDescription: Advance your diving career and become a professional trained to supervise and guide other divers.
cursos.divemaster.description: Learn to lead underwater tours, assist in diving classes, and inspire others to care for the ocean. Hone your skills and become the diver everyone admires. PADI Divemaster is the most popular and recognized professional diving certification in the world. PADI Divemasters enjoy abundant professional opportunities, get paid to dive, and share their love for the ocean. Gain hands-on experience conducting dive briefings, assisting in classes, and leading underwater excursions. Learn to anticipate and address problems, create an Emergency Assistance Plan, and enhance your navigation and problem-solving skills through practical workshops.
cursos.divemaster.duration: Online theory 10-16 hours, full course: variable duration
cursos.divemaster.includes.0: Complete equipment for all your dives
cursos.divemaster.includes.2: In-person theoretical and practical classes with your instructor
cursos.divemaster.requirements.2: Emergency First Response® Primary and Secondary Care within the last 24 months
cursos.divemaster.requirements.4: Medical clearance and authorization to dive from a physician within the last 12 months

contact.faq.snorkeling.question: Do I need to know how to swim to go snorkeling?
contact.faq.snorkeling.answer: No, you don't need to know how to swim. Our snorkeling excursions are suitable for everyone, even those with no prior water experience. You’ll always be accompanied by professional guides and wear a wetsuit that provides full buoyancy at all times.
contact.faq.season.question: What is the best time to dive in Puerto Madryn?
contact.faq.season.answer: Puerto Madryn is a year-round diving destination. Each season offers unique encounters with Patagonian wildlife: from May to November, whales and sea lions stand out; in summer, warmer and more colorful waters. Contact us to find out what you can see based on your visit date.
contact.faq.equipment.question: What do I need to bring for the excursions?
contact.faq.equipment.answer: You only need to bring a swimsuit, towel, and we always recommend sunscreen, a cap, and a change of clothes. We provide all the technical equipment needed for each activity, both diving and snorkeling.
contact.faq.discounts.question: Do you offer group discounts?
contact.faq.discounts.answer: Yes, we offer special rates and customized packages for groups. Write or call us, and we’ll create a tailored proposal for you.

excursions.snorkeling.title: Snorkeling with Sea Lions
excursions.snorkeling.miniDescription: Experience the unique adventure of swimming with sea lions in their natural habitat.
excursions.snorkeling.description.0: Embark on an unforgettable adventure as you snorkel alongside curious sea lions in their natural habitat. Guided by our experienced captain and specialized guides, you’ll be taken to the Punta Loma Natural Area.
excursions.snorkeling.description.1: During the boat trip to the reserve, you’ll be amazed by the incredible local wildlife, including penguins, dolphins, whales, and cormorants, depending on the time of year.
excursions.snorkeling.description.2: Once at the reserve, sea lions will swim freely around you, approaching out of their own curiosity. This close and natural interaction guarantees magical moments that will stay with you forever.
excursions.snorkeling.details.guide.desc: Present to assist, guide, and accompany you at all times.
excursions.snorkeling.details.forAll.des: Ideal for families, friends, or adventurous individuals.
excursions.snorkeling.details.noExperien: No previous experience or swimming skills required.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.equip: We’ll provide all necessary equipment, including mask, snorkel, wetsuit, and fins.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.brief: We start with a short explanation of snorkeling basics and safety protocols.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.boatT: Our experienced captains will take you on a boat trip to the Punta Loma Natural Reserve. Along the way, you’ll have the chance to spot a wide variety of wildlife, such as penguins, dolphins, whales, and cormorants, depending on the season.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.guide: Our guides will accompany you in the Punta Loma Natural Reserve, where you can get close to sea lions in their natural environment and enjoy a safe and exciting experience.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.wildl: Enjoy close interaction with sea lions as they swim around you in their natural environment.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.retur: At the end of the experience, you’ll enjoy the return boat trip, taking in the stunning Patagonian landscapes. Back at the dive center, you can share your impressions and memories of this unforgettable adventure.
excursions.snorkeling.requirements.minAg: The minimum age to participate is 6 years in summer and 8 years in winter (please consult).
excursions.snorkeling.requirements.physi: If you are over 65 years old, you must provide a medical certificate of good health.
excursions.snorkeling.requirements.healt: It’s important to have no heart conditions or other medical issues that could pose risks due to boat movement, basic/moderate physical effort, or cold water exposure.
excursions.snorkeling.callToAction.0.tex: Ready to experience unique snorkeling? Book your adventure now and discover the magic of being close to sea lions!
excursions.bautismo.title: Discover Scuba Diving
excursions.bautismo.miniDescription: Dive into the underwater world and embark on an adventure with us.
excursions.bautismo.description.0: Want to experience diving for the first time? The Discover Scuba Diving program is the simplest way to enter this world, with no need to know how to swim or have prior experience. Your instructor will be with you at all times, handling the equipment so you can focus on enjoying the experience.
excursions.bautismo.description.1: Diving allows you to float freely underwater, as if you were flying. It’s a unique sensation that combines adventure, tranquility, and a deep connection with the environment. You’ll explore the underwater landscapes of Patagonia and come face-to-face with fish, starfish, and other wonders of the ocean floor.
excursions.bautismo.description.2: Unlike other experiences, this introductory dive requires no theory or equipment handling. It’s designed so anyone can join and experience this magical adventure with complete confidence!
excursions.bautismo.description.3: Looking for a more comprehensive first experience? The Discover Scuba Diving program is ideal if you’d like to learn more about this world. In this program, you’ll learn to handle the equipment, move independently underwater, and explore diving in greater depth. Plus, it’s the starting point if you’d like to pursue a diving course in the future.
excursions.bautismo.details.duration.des: 1 hour and 30 minutes, with 20 minutes dedicated to practice and the dive.
excursions.bautismo.details.forAll.title: For Everyone
excursions.bautismo.details.forAll.descr: No prior experience or swimming skills required; anyone can join this excursion.
excursions.bautismo.details.underwater.d: Discover the incredible marine diversity found in Patagonia!
excursions.bautismo.whatToExpect.equipme: We’ll provide the wetsuit at our facility before heading to the dive site. The rest of the equipment, including mask, regulator, and tank, will be provided at the dive location.
excursions.bautismo.whatToExpect.briefin: We start with a short explanation of what you need to know for your experience, covering basic knowledge while the instructor takes care of the rest.
excursions.bautismo.whatToExpect.practic: You’ll conduct a surface practice to familiarize yourself with the equipment and diving techniques.
excursions.bautismo.whatToExpect.dive.de: Our instructors will lead you on a controlled dive, managing the equipment while you focus on exploring the underwater world alongside fish, starfish, anemones, and other wonders of the marine ecosystem.
At the end of the experience, you’ll return to the dive center, where you can share your impressions and receive a brief evaluation from your instructor.
The minimum age to participate is 8 years (consult for more details).
excursions.bautismo.requirements.physica: If you are over 65 years old, you must provide a medical certificate of good health.
It’s important to have no heart conditions, respiratory issues, or other medical conditions that could pose a risk during the dive.
excursions.bautismo.callToAction.0.text: Ready to discover the underwater world? Book your scuba diving experience now and start your underwater adventure with us!
excursions.delfines.title: Boat Tour in Search of Dolphins
excursions.delfines.miniDescription: Embark on an unforgettable adventure in search of dolphins.
excursions.delfines.description.0: Sail through the waters of Golfo Nuevo in search of the fascinating dusky dolphins. Aboard our 9-meter semi-rigid boat, you’ll experience an exciting and highly personalized adventure, with a maximum of 15 passengers. Our boat departs directly from the beach, immersing you in the magic of the Patagonian sea.
excursions.delfines.description.1: Guided by our expert captains, we’ll navigate to areas frequented by dolphins. These animals, known for their energy, acrobatics, and curiosity, often approach the boat, offering an unforgettable natural spectacle.
excursions.delfines.description.2: In addition to spotting various bird species and local wildlife, depending on the route, you may see iconic locations such as the Folías Shipwreck, Punta Cuevas, or El Doradillo. Perfect for families, friends, and individual adventurers.
excursions.delfines.details.duration.des: Approximately 2 hours (may extend depending on sea conditions and sightings).
excursions.delfines.details.forAll.title: For Everyone
excursions.delfines.details.smallGroup.d: Maximum of 15 passengers for a personalized experience.
excursions.delfines.details.boarding.des: Directly from the shore, please wear clothing and footwear suitable for getting wet up to the knees.
excursions.delfines.whatToExpect.equipme: Our vessel is equipped with safety gear and life jackets for all passengers.
excursions.delfines.whatToExpect.guidedT: We head to the waters of Golfo Nuevo, where our bilingual guides will provide information about the diverse variety of birds and marine wildlife, while also visiting historical and iconic locations.
We conclude our journey by returning to the shore, where you can share your impressions and memories of this wonderful experience.
excursions.delfines.callToAction.text: Ready to live an unforgettable adventure at sea? Book your tour now and come discover the magic of dusky dolphins in their natural habitat!
excursions.delfines.title.noRequirements: Image of dolphins jumping in the sea
excursions.salidas.title: Private Tours
excursions.salidas.miniDescription: Customize your experience with exclusive tours for you and your group.
excursions.salidas.description.0: Looking for a unique and personalized experience in the crystal-clear waters of Patagonia? Our private semi-rigid boat tours are the perfect choice. With a capacity for up to 15 passengers, we offer a full morning of adventure and exploration in an unparalleled natural setting, tailored to your preferences and needs.
With a small group, our guides can focus on providing more detailed and personalized attention, ensuring your experience is safe and memorable.
excursions.salidas.details.flexibility.d: Enjoy the flexibility to choose your favorite activities and tailor the itinerary to your interests.
excursions.salidas.details.exclusive.des: Access less crowded diving and snorkeling sites, enjoying the tranquility and beauty of Patagonia without the crowds.
excursions.salidas.whatToExpect.snorkeli: Dive into the waters and enjoy the company of these playful marine animals in their natural habitat. Guided by our professional instructors, you’ll have the chance to get close to curious sea lions and observe their behaviors up close.
excursions.salidas.whatToExpect.diving.d: If you’re a certified diver or want to experience your first dive, you can explore the fascinating underwater world of Patagonia. Discover shipwrecks, colorful reefs, and the abundant marine life that inhabits these waters.
excursions.salidas.whatToExpect.dolphinT: Boat Tours in Search of Dolphins
Sail through the waters in search of friendly dolphins. These tours not only offer the thrill of spotting dolphins but also the chance to enjoy the stunning marine landscapes.
excursions.salidas.callToAction.text: Don’t miss the chance to live a unique and personalized experience in Patagonia. Contact us today to book your private semi-rigid boat tour and get ready for a morning full of adventures and discoveries.

our.store2: Our shop is much more than a meeting point: it also functions as a small museum. You'll be able to admire various objects recovered from the seabed, along with fossils and whale baleen that are part of the local natural history. We invite you to discover it all.
our.history2: We are a family-run business with over 40 years of experience sharing the Patagonian sea. Two generations dedicated to creating unforgettable experiences at sea. We love what we do and share it with every person who dares to discover these waters.
our.staff2: We are a team of PADI-certified professionals with experience in diver training, recreational outings, and personalized support in the Patagonian Sea.

marcelo.d: Founder of Madryn Buceo. A captain with over 40 years of experience, he has accompanied thousands of passengers on their first diving and snorkeling experience.
lucio.d: Company manager and PADI course instructor. He supports the company with his charisma, good sense of humor, and passion for diving.
julian.d: PADI captain and instructor with extensive experience. He has been with the company for over 15 years. A football fan and Estudiantes supporter.

camila.d: A Dive Master trained at our center and a future marine biologist, she accompanies us on excursions, spreading her enthusiasm for marine life with a very special tune.
diveSites.primavera.name: Primavera Wreck
diveSites.primavera.description: A small fishing boat and the newest wreck in our gulf, currently in the process of being fully populated with marine life.
diveSites.albatros.name: Albatros Wreck
diveSites.albatros.description: The Albatros is a 30-meter fishing vessel sunk in September 1998 to create a recreational dive site, teeming with life due to its age.
diveSites.miralles.name: Miralles Wreck
diveSites.miralles.description: In March 2004, this 70-meter vessel was sunk to create a recreational dive site. It has large internal spaces allowing safe penetrations and hosts a wide variety of marine life.
diveSites.urabain.name: Urabain Wreck
diveSites.urabain.description: In 2018, a refrigerated fishing vessel was sunk to create a new dive site, offering a large structure to explore underwater.
diveSites.chinoHushung.name: Hu Shun Yu 809 Wreck
diveSites.chinoHushung.description: A Chinese fishing vessel seized in 2016 for illegal fishing in Argentine waters by the naval prefecture. It measures 78 meters in length.
diveSites.folias.name: Folias Wreck
diveSites.folias.description: A 72-meter fishing vessel sunk in the early 80s off the coast of Playa Paraná, victim of an intentional fire. Part of its structure emerges above the surface.
diveSites.emma.name: Emma Wreck
diveSites.emma.description: A wooden schooner that performed various tasks along the Patagonian coasts of Chile and Argentina. It sank in 1947 off Puerto Madryn after a fire.
diveSites.parqueNuevo.name: Parque Nuevo
diveSites.parqueNuevo.description: An artificial park formed by various attractions such as parts of boats and airplane remains, overtaken by the local nature.
diveSites.puntaCuevas.name: Punta Cuevas Natural Park
diveSites.puntaCuevas.description: A beautiful natural reef with a rocky bottom featuring underwater canyons inhabited by a rich diversity of fish and invertebrates. It stands out for the variety of colorful polyps covering its overhangs.
diveSites.caletaParana.name: Paraná Cove (Punta Este Reef)
diveSites.caletaParana.description: A simple dive site ideal for first experiences or training, showcasing the natural seabed of our waters teeming with marine life.
diveSites.puntaLoma.name: Punta Loma Natural Reserve
diveSites.puntaLoma.description: A natural reserve with a stable sea lion colony where we dive surrounded by these beautiful and friendly animals, in addition to seeing the natural seabed full of marine diversity.
diveSites.lasPiedras.name: Las Piedras Park
diveSites.lasPiedras.description: The rocky natural reef structure provides multiple shelters for marine fauna, making it a highly attractive spot for recreational diving and underwater photography.
diving.des: Discover the best diving spots in the region.
diveCertification.title: Dive in Puerto Madryn
diveCertification.description.subTitle: Experience something unique
diveCertification.description.text1: More than 6 shipwrecks ideal for unforgettable underwater explorations.
diveCertification.description.text2: Immerse yourself in natural rocky parks full of marine life.
diveCertification.description.text3: Enjoy diving with sea lions in their natural habitat, a unique experience available year-round.
diveCertification.description.text4: Discover more than 12 dive sites for all levels.
diveCertification.description.text5: Don't miss the opportunity to snorkel with sea lions!
diveCertification.description2.title: Description
diveCertification.description2.text6.1: Discover the underwater wonders of Puerto Madryn, the National Diving Capital. This unique destination awaits you with exclusive experiences for certified divers, in an unparalleled natural environment.
diveCertification.description2.text6.2: Immerse yourself in Patagonian waters and explore marine biodiversity, including close encounters with sea lions, historic shipwrecks, and impressive rock formations full of life.
diveCertification.description2.text6.3: Guided by our experienced instructors, we offer you a series of dives that will challenge and enrich your diving skills, guaranteeing an unforgettable adventure. We recommend at least 4 dives to enjoy all our attractions.
diveCertification.whatToExpect.title: What to Expect?
diveCertification.whatToExpect.text1.tex: We will provide all necessary equipment, including wetsuit, mask, fins, BCD, regulator, and 1 tank for each dive.
diveCertification.whatToExpect.text2.tex: We begin with a brief explanation of the diving basics and specific safety protocols for each dive site.
diveCertification.whatToExpect.text3.tex: Our experienced captains will take you to the dive site, and along the way, there's the possibility to spot an incredible variety of marine fauna, such as penguins, dolphins, and cormorants, depending on the time of year.
diveCertification.whatToExpect.text4.tex: The complete excursion lasts approximately 2 hours, depending on the number of dives you make, which can be up to 2 in one day.
diveCertification.whatToExpect.text5.tex: After the dive, we'll return to the center enjoying the surroundings. Once there, you can share your experiences with our team and other tourists, sharing memories and anecdotes of the adventure.
diveCertification.requirements.title: Requirements
diveCertification.requirements.text1.tex: The minimum age to participate is 12 years old.
diveCertification.requirements.text2.tex: If you are over 65 years old, you must have a medical certificate of good health.
diveCertification.requirements.text3.tex: Appropriate certification is required according to the depth of the dive site.
diveCertification.requirements.text4.tex: It is important not to have heart disease or other medical conditions that may present problems due to physical exertion and impact with cold water.
diveCertification.seaLobos.title: Diving with Sea Lions
diveCertification.seaLobos.text: Dare to live a unique experience diving with sea lions in their natural habitat.
diveCertification.seaLobos.text2: This experience includes a picturesque nautical trip of 20 km navigation to the protected area of Punta Loma Natural Reserve and is specifically designed for certified divers who want to dive with sea lions.
diveCertification.seaLobos.text3: Within the reserve, we also have the option of a Snorkeling with sea lions excursion.
diveCertification.tablePrice.title: Options and Prices
diveCertification.tablePrice.text4: 1 Dive with sea lions + 1 Extra dive
diveCertification.imageAlt: Certified diver exploring the waters of Puerto Madryn
diveCertification.tablePrice.intro: Choose the dive that best fits your trip. All prices are shown in Argentine pesos and booking is confirmed through Outtrip.
diveSites.intro: Explore shipwrecks, underwater parks and natural seabeds. Filter by certification and open each site to learn about its conditions.
